verdict.rationale: Mintlify ships its own agents (the editor agent, the docs agent and the assistant), so being an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, every MCP item in the pack describes Mintlify acting as an MCP server (search, admin and Index servers) that outside AI tools connect to. There is no evidence that users can plug external MCP servers into Mintlify's agents so they can use those servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
